name: 抗疲劳镜片下加光设计器

map.根据年龄、调节幅度和工作距离计算建议下加光(ADD)，设计抗疲劳方案: Compute the recommended near addition (ADD) from age, amplitude of accommodation and working distance to design an anti-fatigue scheme
map.📖 查看「抗疲劳镜片下加光设计器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Anti-Fatigue Lens Near Addition Designer User Guide"
map.下加光 Add = max(0, 100/工作距cm − (调节幅度 − 调节幅: Near addition Add = max(0, 100/working distance cm − (amplitude of accommodation − amplitude/3)), quantized to 0.25D, capped at 1.00D
map.按 Hofstetter 平均调节幅度，保留 1/3 调节力，超出部分作为抗疲劳: Per the Hofstetter average amplitude of accommodation, reserving 1/3 of accommodative power, the excess becomes the anti-fatigue near addition; amplitude of accommodation = 18.5 − 0.30×age.
map.基础设计：根据年龄推算调节幅度，结合工作距离计算调节需求和保留量。: Basic design: derive the amplitude of accommodation from age and compute the accommodative demand and reserve from the working distance.
map.进阶设计：基于双眼视功能检查数据（调节幅度、隐斜、NRA/PRA）精确计算下加光: Advanced design: precisely compute the near addition from binocular vision examination data (amplitude of accommodation, heterophoria, NRA/PRA).
map.抗疲劳镜片下加光一般不超过1.00D，超过建议使用渐进多焦点镜片。ADD过大可能: Anti-fatigue lens near additions generally do not exceed 1.00D; above that a progressive multifocal lens is recommended. An excessive ADD may affect distance vision.
map.工作距离的倒数：调节需求 = 100 / 距离(cm)。如40cm工作距离 =: The reciprocal of the working distance: accommodative demand = 100 / distance (cm). For example, a 40 cm working distance = 2.50D.
map.舒适用眼需保留调节幅度的1/2-1/3。若调节需求超过可用调节的2/3，则需要下: Comfortable vision requires reserving 1/2-1/3 of the amplitude of accommodation. If the accommodative demand exceeds 2/3 of the available accommodation, a near addition is needed for compensation.
map.最小调节幅度 = 15 − 0.25 × 年龄；平均调节幅度 = 18.5 −: Minimum amplitude of accommodation = 15 − 0.25 × age; average = 18.5 − 0.30 × age; maximum = 25 − 0.40 × age.
map.NRA与PRA应相对平衡。若PRA绝对值大于NRA，提示调节紧张，需下加光补偿差: NRA and PRA should be relatively balanced. If the absolute value of PRA exceeds NRA, it indicates accommodative strain, requiring a near addition compensating half the difference.
map.抗疲劳镜片设计需结合年龄、用眼习惯和双眼视功能综合评估，建议在验光师指导下验配。: Anti-fatigue lens design requires a comprehensive assessment combining age, visual habits and binocular vision; fitting under the guidance of an optometrist is recommended.
map.长时间用眼者加轻度下加缓解调节紧张。: Add a mild near addition for those with prolonged near work to relieve accommodative strain.
map.与渐进片区别（仅下加、无远中近多焦）。: Difference from progressive lenses (near addition only, without far-intermediate-near multifocality).
map.视功能检查后定下加量。: Determine the near addition amount after a visual function examination.
map.长时间看屏、调节滞后者加 +0.50D～+0.75D 下加，缓解睫状肌紧张；若集: For those with prolonged screen time or accommodative lag, add a +0.50D to +0.75D near addition to relieve ciliary muscle strain; if there is convergence insufficiency, combine with vision training rather than relying on the addition alone.
map.抗疲劳片仅在视近区加光，远用区平光，不同于渐进片的全景通道，适用 20–40 岁: Anti-fatigue lenses add power only in the near zone with a plano distance zone, unlike the panoramic corridor of progressive lenses; suitable for people aged 20-40 with eye strain.
map.抗疲劳片=老花镜吗？: Are anti-fatigue lenses the same as reading glasses?
map.不是。老花是中老年远用不清需全时加光；抗疲劳是年轻人视近加微光缓解疲劳，远用仍清: No. Presbyopia is unclear distance vision in middle-aged and older people requiring full-time addition; anti-fatigue lenses add slight power for near vision in younger people to relieve fatigue while distance vision remains clear.
map.下加越大越好？: Is a larger near addition better?
map.否。过大会致远用模糊与适应困难，按调节滞后量定，通常 ≤+0.75D。: No. Too large causes distance blur and adaptation difficulty; it is set by the accommodative lag, usually ≤+0.75D.
